"""Full pretrained 9B native Trainer backward and independent CE oracle regression.

Before and after use identical model, text, dtype, microbatches and initial weights.
No optimizer step: this regression isolates the pretraining objective and gradients.
"""
import argparse, hashlib, importlib.metadata, inspect, json, os, pathlib, time
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--arm',choices=['before','after'],required=True);p.add_argument('--output',required=True);a=p.parse_args()
ROOT=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
if a.arm=='after':
    import sys
    sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'vendor'))
import torch, torch_npu
import numpy as np
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, Trainer, TrainingArguments
OUT=pathlib.Path(a.output);OUT.mkdir()
start=time.monotonic();torch.manual_seed(17);torch.npu.set_device(0)
MODEL='/home/work/user-job-dir/app/slai/user-xiexinyuan/xinyuan/models/qwen35-base-68c46c4-precision-20261012T141602Z'
tokenizer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL,local_files_only=True)
texts=['The Earth orbits the Sun.', 'Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius under standard atmospheric pressure. The freezing point changes with pressure and dissolved substances, while the boiling point also depends on atmospheric conditions.']
batches=[]
for text in texts:
    ids=tokenizer(text,return_tensors='pt',add_special_tokens=False)['input_ids']
    batches.append({'input_ids':ids,'attention_mask':torch.ones_like(ids),'labels':ids.clone()})
print('LOAD_MODEL',flush=True)
model,loading=Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained(MODEL,torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,local_files_only=True,attn_implementation='eager',output_loading_info=True)
assert not loading['missing_keys'] and not loading['unexpected_keys'] and not loading['mismatched_keys'],loading
model.to('npu:0'); model.config.use_cache=False
args=TrainingArguments(output_dir=str(OUT/'trainer'),per_device_train_batch_size=1,gradient_accumulation_steps=2,report_to=[],save_strategy='no',logging_strategy='no',bf16=False,fp16=False,disable_tqdm=True,optim='sgd',seed=17)
trainer=Trainer(model=model,args=args)
trainer.current_gradient_accumulation_steps=2
assert trainer.model_accepts_loss_kwargs == (a.arm=='after')
batch_samples,denom=trainer.get_batch_samples(iter(batches),2,args.device)
valid=sum(int(b['labels'][...,1:].ne(-100).sum()) for b in batches)
print('DENOM',(int(denom) if denom is not None else None),'VALID',valid,'lengths',[b['input_ids'].shape[-1] for b in batches],flush=True)
# Capture an entire small native parameter gradient, plus selected output-head rows.
names=dict(model.named_parameters())
small_name=next(n for n in names if n.endswith('layers.31.mlp.down_proj.weight'))
# Whole selected matrix remains remote; local export is only a summary.
head_name=next(n for n in names if n.endswith('lm_head.weight'))
row_ids=torch.unique(torch.cat([b['labels'].flatten() for b in batches])).to('npu:0')
def capture(tag):
    torch.npu.synchronize()
    grad=names[small_name].grad.detach().float().cpu().numpy()
    head=names[head_name].grad.detach().index_select(0,row_ids).float().cpu().numpy()
    np.save(OUT/(tag+'-layer31-down-grad.npy'),grad)
    np.save(OUT/(tag+'-head-target-grad.npy'),head)
    return {'layer31_down':grad,'head_targets':head}
model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
losses=[]
for b in batch_samples:
    loss=trainer.training_step(model,{k:v.clone() for k,v in b.items()},num_items_in_batch=denom)
    losses.append(float(loss));print('TRAIN_MICRO',losses[-1],flush=True)
observed=capture('trainer')
model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
reference_losses=[]
for b in batches:
    inputs={k:v.to(args.device) for k,v in b.items() if k!='labels'}
    logits=model(**inputs,use_cache=False).logits.float()
    target=b['labels'][...,1:].to(args.device)
    loss=torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits[...,:-1,:].contiguous().view(-1,logits.shape[-1]),target.reshape(-1),reduction='sum')/valid
    reference_losses.append(float(loss.detach()));trainer.accelerator.backward(loss);del logits,loss
    print('ORACLE_MICRO',reference_losses[-1],flush=True)
reference=capture('oracle')
# Compare through shared artifact arithmetic, not a private metrics implementation.
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT.parents[3]/'skills/precision-compare/scripts'))
from array_compare import compare_arrays
comparison=compare_arrays(observed,reference,metrics=True)
(OUT/'gradient-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(comparison,indent=2))
loss_observed=sum(losses);loss_reference=sum(reference_losses)
checks={'target_count':(int(denom) if denom is not None else None)==valid,'loss_mean':abs(loss_observed-loss_reference)<2e-5,'gradient_layer31':bool(np.allclose(observed['layer31_down'],reference['layer31_down'],rtol=.02,atol=1e-6)),'gradient_head':bool(np.allclose(observed['head_targets'],reference['head_targets'],rtol=.02,atol=1e-6))}
result={'arm':a.arm,'classification':'defect in installed upstream Transformers v5.3.0; no historical bug injection','loss':loss_observed,'oracle_loss':loss_reference,'loss_absolute_error':abs(loss_observed-loss_reference),'loss_ratio':loss_observed/loss_reference,'trainer_denominator':(int(denom) if denom is not None else None),'valid_next_token_targets':valid,'checks':checks,'passed':all(checks.values()),'texts':texts,'input_ids':[b['input_ids'].tolist() for b in batches],'dtype':str(next(model.parameters()).dtype),'parameters_loaded':sum(x.numel() for x in model.parameters()),'num_hidden_layers':model.config.text_config.num_hidden_layers,'loading_info':{k:sorted(v) if isinstance(v,set) else v for k,v in loading.items()},'model_accepts_loss_kwargs':trainer.model_accepts_loss_kwargs,'gradient_parameter':small_name,'gradient_head_rows':row_ids.cpu().tolist(),'optimizer_steps':0,'scope':'full text-model backward with native Trainer.training_step; unused vision tower loaded; no optimizer update verification','oracle_backward':'same Accelerator.backward as native Trainer, independent CE objective','accelerator_gradient_accumulation_steps':trainer.accelerator.gradient_accumulation_steps,'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'peak_npu_allocated_bytes':torch.npu.max_memory_allocated(),'versions':{n:importlib.metadata.version(n) for n in ['torch','torch-npu','transformers','accelerate']},'trainer_source':inspect.getfile(Trainer),'trainer_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(inspect.getfile(Trainer)).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'device':torch.npu.get_device_name(0),'visible_devices':os.environ.get('ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES')}
(OUT/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
assert result['passed'], 'Native pretraining target-count/loss/gradient regression failed'

"""CPU structural regressions against the actual Trainer counting implementation.
No model initialization or synthesized defect; tensor fixtures cover label alignment.
"""
import argparse, json, pathlib, sys, types
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--patched',action='store_true');a=p.parse_args()
ROOT=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
if a.patched:sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'vendor'))
import torch
from transformers import Trainer

def ForCausalLMLoss():pass
def ForMaskedLMLoss():pass

def trainer(loss=ForCausalLMLoss, custom=None, smoother=None):
    return types.SimpleNamespace(model=types.SimpleNamespace(loss_function=loss),compute_loss_func=custom,label_smoother=smoother,model_accepts_loss_kwargs=True,args=types.SimpleNamespace(average_tokens_across_devices=False,n_gpu=0),accelerator=types.SimpleNamespace(parallelism_config=None))

fixtures=[
 ('causal_unmasked',trainer(),[{'labels':torch.tensor([[3,4,5,6]])}],3),
 ('causal_ignored_prefix',trainer(),[{'labels':torch.tensor([[-100,-100,5,6]])}],2),
 ('causal_padding',trainer(),[{'labels':torch.tensor([[3,4,5,-100,-100]])}],2),
 ('causal_shift_labels',trainer(),[{'labels':torch.tensor([[3,4,5]]),'shift_labels':torch.tensor([[4,5,-100]])}],2),
 ('masked_lm_unchanged',trainer(ForMaskedLMLoss),[{'labels':torch.tensor([[3,4,-100]])}],2),
 ('custom_loss_unchanged',trainer(custom=lambda:None),[{'labels':torch.tensor([[3,4,5]])}],3),
 ('smoother_unchanged',trainer(smoother=object()),[{'labels':torch.tensor([[3,4,5]])}],3),
 ('accumulated_unequal',trainer(),[{'labels':torch.tensor([[3,4,5]])},{'labels':torch.tensor([[3,4,5,6,7]])}],6),
]
results=[]
for name,t,batches,expected in fixtures:
    actual=int(Trainer._get_num_items_in_batch(t,batches,torch.device('cpu')))
    results.append({'name':name,'actual':actual,'expected':expected,'passed':actual==expected})
print(json.dumps({'patched':a.patched,'tests':results,'passed':all(r['passed'] for r in results)},indent=2))
sys.exit(0 if all(r['passed'] for r in results) else 1)
